description: Register a pricing function in your workspace. execution_type is how it prices: rule based, ML model, LLM prompt, external API (your own endpoint) or composite. name is its unique lowercase id, such as acme/surge. Set is_public to list it for other workspaces. A new function starts as a draft unless status is active: make it active with update_function to have it routed to. A rule_based function prices by the rule you send (base, then steps such as margin, tiers, floor and price ending). Needs a Last Price credential with function publish scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

auth_config.description: How to authenticate to the endpoint, such as { type: "bearer", token: "..." }. Stored encrypted and never returned: a read says only whether one is saved. On update an object replaces it and null removes it. Treat the secret as sensitive: it passes through this conversation.

cost_multiplier.description: Multiplies the cost of each call, for a more expensive model tier. 1 is the default; stored to 4 decimal places.

cost_per_unit.description: What one call to the function costs, in USD.

display_name.description: The name people and agents see.

endpoint_url.description: For a function that calls your own service: the https endpoint that returns the price.

execution_type.description: How the function computes a price.

inference_config.description: For a function that runs on a model. On update an object replaces it and null removes it, so the function uses the rule-based formula.

model.description: The model id at that provider.

prompt.description: Your pricing instructions for the model.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema of what a price request supplies to the function.

is_public.description: List it for other workspaces to use. Defaults to false.

name.description: Unique lowercase id: letters, digits, hyphens, underscores and slashes.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema of what the function returns.

quote_valid_seconds.description: How long a price this function computes stays valid, in seconds (30 to 86400). Prices carry it as valid_until where quote expiry is switched on for the workspace. Omit for the default of 15 minutes; on update null returns to the default.

rule.description: For a rule based function: the rule it prices by. Its input schema is made from the rule, and a rule based function needs one before it can be active. On update null removes it.

base.description: Where the price starts: {"from":"current_price"}, {"from":"unit_cost"}, {"from":"competitor_prices","pick":"min"|"avg"|"max"} or {"from":"field","field":"<context field>"}.

steps.description: Applied in order: adjust_pct, margin (target_margin_pct), scale, tiers, floor, ceiling, ending (cents such as 0.99) and round. A floor or ceiling holds through every later step.

status.description: draft (the default) or active, to have it routed to at once. A self-registered sandbox saves drafts only.

tags.description: The tag list. On update it replaces the whole list.

name: create_function
